texts.arguments: this Court in The Swedish Club Vs. V8 Pool Inc., & Other 1. All these safeguards cannot simply be bypassed by suggesting that the Deputy Conservator at an indeterminate time, through oral instructions, This Order is modified/corrected by Speaking to Minutes Order dated 02/04/2024 3-Sheriff Report 14.24 in COMAS 14.2023.doc instructed the Applicant to make the supplies. Vessel under arrest as Sheriff's expenses is obliged to seek prior sanction and/or approval of the Court or the Sheriff to enjoy a higher priority in the distribution of proceeds of a judicial sale of the Vessel. It is absurd to suggest that all expenses incurred post-arrest of a Vessel are Sheriff's expenses; and, in fairness to the advocates of the Applicant, even they have not canvassed such an extreme proposition. Even if these were part- payments, the balance due to the Applicant is from the Owner (for which it can file proceedings like other creditors); not the Sheriff. Louis Pappas Corp vs Mv Kaptan Hasan Onal Imo 9539559 on 26 March, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/99541864/ 5 20. The Applicant is required to file an independent Suit for its claims and is not left without redress. No prejudice will be caused to the Applicant as their right to approach this Court and make a claim against the sale proceeds remains. However, it ought not to ignore the established principles for treating expenses as Sheriff's expenses. He This Order is modified/corrected by Speaking to Minutes Order dated 02/04/2024 3-Sheriff Report 14.24 in COMAS 14.2023.doc has submitted that in view of non-abandonment of the Defendant- Vessel during the relevant time and atleast until 18 th August, 2023, as borne out from the orders of this Court, this Court ought not to have the Applicant's expenses treated as Sheriff's expenses as the same would operate to seriously dilute the principles of Sheriff's expenses. He has referred to the relevant Rule 1084 of the Bombay High Court (Original side) Rules, 1980 ("Rules"). He has submitted that upon a reading of the said Rule, it is clear that all expenses are required to be incurred for the safety and preservation of the Vessel and its crew during the period the Vessel remains under arrest shall be treated as Sheriff's expenses. What is important is the expenses that are incurred are (i) incurred post arrest; (ii) are incurred either for the safety and preservation of the Vessel or its crew during arrest. The Vessel cannot be left unmanned as it can pose a threat to life, property, environment. The manning ensures safety of the Vessel as well as property and people around the Vessel. Therefore, it is essential that the crew which remains on board the Vessel is provided with basic requirement This Order is modified/corrected by Speaking to Minutes Order dated 02/04/2024 3-Sheriff Report 14.24 in COMAS 14.2023.doc of food, water and other essentials which are essential for their survival on Louis Pappas Corp vs Mv Kaptan Hasan Onal Imo 9539559 However, absence of such a leave cannot be treated as fatal to the claim of a person who supplies necessaries to the Vessel and the crew post arrest, in all situations. The Admiralty Court is not precluded from declaring such expenses by a person without its leave as Sheriff's expenses. The guidelines laid down in Swedish Club Judgment cannot be treated as an absolute proposition of law which would impose fetters on the Admiralty Court from treating certain expenses without its leave for the sustenance of the crew on board the Vessel as Sheriff's expenses. Louis Pappas Corp vs Mv Kaptan Hasan Onal Imo 9539559 on 26 March, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/99541864/ 8 36.
